title: Gentleman-Programming External Engineering Ecosystem Benchmark
author: EOS Engineering Intelligence Researcher & Architectural Auditor
objective: Evaluate external Gentleman-Programming ecosystem components (Engram, Gentle-AI, SDD, Gentleman-Skills, Context7, GGA) to establish an empirical ADOPT / ADAPT / REJECT matrix for EOS integration without compromising EOS Control Plane governance or zero-write safety barriers.

evaluations.function: Persistent local-first agent memory via SQLite + FTS5 MCP server
evaluations.rationale: Engram provides persistent memory across sessions and compactions without inflating parent context. Bound via Engram Protocol rules.
evaluations.eosIntegration: Active via Engram MCP tools (mem_save, mem_search, mem_context, mem_session_summary)

evaluations.function: Agent configurator, context delegation boundaries, prompt envelope discipline
evaluations.rationale: Gentle-AI context delegation rules (bounded subagents for 4+ files read) complement EOS 16-state execution runtime and policy engine.
evaluations.eosIntegration: Delegation thresholds integrated into EOS Agent Council and Policy Engine

evaluations.function: Spec-Driven Development lifecycle (explore, propose, spec, design, tasks, apply, verify, archive)
evaluations.rationale: EOS already implements 16-state execution runtime and 18-dimensional strategy selection. SDD lifecycle steps map 1:1 to EOS execution phases.
evaluations.eosIntegration: EOS Engineering Lifecycle maps SDD phases to EOS decision records and evidence bounds

evaluations.function: Domain-specialized skills (TypeScript, Astro, React, Tailwind, Zod, Playwright)
evaluations.rationale: Skills provide operational domain expertise without introducing executable runtime bloat or circular verification risks.
evaluations.eosIntegration: Loaded into EOS .agents/skills/ directory as declarative markdown instruction sets

evaluations.function: Live framework and library documentation retrieval to eliminate API obsolescence
evaluations.rationale: Live documentation retrieval prevents stale LLM assumptions. Integrated as read-only research adapter.
evaluations.eosIntegration: Bound via mock-research-adapter and read_url_content tools under Level 1 READ_ONLY mode

evaluations.function: External AI code review using multi-provider models
evaluations.rationale: External code review provides independent cross-model corroboration without circular self-certification.
evaluations.eosIntegration: Positioned as Level 2 independent reviewer in EOS Independent Verification Harness

matrixSummary.conclusion: External ecosystem components significantly complement EOS control plane governance when bound strictly to Level 1 READ_ONLY and independent non-circular verification rules.
